events.summary: Haakon joins Heidar's plan to counteract the World Spell and reverse the Thaw.
events.quote: Haakon joined the cause of Heidar in his plan to counteract the World Spell

events.summary: Haakon duels King Darien from dusk till dawn on the fourth day of the Battle of Kjeldor.
events.quote: Haakon fought a duel against King Darien that lasted from dusk till dawn.

events.summary: Darien's men rush Haakon; he cuts many down but is overwhelmed and dies, and his army retreats, ending the battle.
events.quote: His army quickly retreated upon his death, ending the battle of Kjeldor.

relations.quote: Haakon was the undead leader of the Order of Stromgald in Terisiare
